reason: After reviewing the Central Garden & Pet Company (CENT) 10-K filing for fiscal year 2025, no Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures were disclosed by the company. The filing contains business descriptions, strategy discussions, and references to third-party market research sources (National Gardening Survey, Freedonia Group, Packaged Facts, APPA, IBIS World, U.S. Census Bureau), but the company itself did not publish specific TAM figures for its Pet or Garden segments in this filing or cite such figures from investor presentations, earnings calls, or other company-disclosed sources.
